description: Every source series the analyst SDK's clients read that no other collector requests for them (issue 1514): commodity futures, the research ETFs, MSTR and the crypto assets, plus BTC-USD, QQQ and GLD, which are listed under the storage key another collector already records them in so they are not fetched twice. Each id is <provider>:<symbol> (D74). Every series is requested from COLLECTION_START (2016-01-01). Prices are Yahoo's adjusted close (dividend- and split-adjusted for ETFs and MSTR; futures and crypto pay none, so their close is served). A gap or late inception is served as it is and named in limitation.

series.limitation: NYSE trading days only: no weekend or holiday rows.
Gold is the SPDR Gold Shares ETF price, not the spot gold price. NYSE trading days only: no weekend or holiday rows.

series.units: USD per troy ounce, daily close
series.limitation: Gold futures (COMEX), Yahoo's continuous front-month futures contract: the roll from one contract to the next is not adjusted. Exchange trading days only.
